text:
maya: Heads up — support ticket #C-9123 reports sustained p99 > 3s on /v1/generate for tenant 'solstice' starting ~08:15 UTC. Customers seeing timeouts + some 502s. Grafana: https://grafana.internal/r/solstice-p99 :rotating_light:
sre-bot: Alert: p99 latency for route /v1/generate tenant solstice spiked to 3.8s at 2026-03-17T08:17Z. Incident ID: INC-4281
chris: Assigning to eng-oncall. @oz can you triage? Any deploys/rollouts around that time?
oz: On it. Pulling traces. Does support have a repro? Any model pinned for this tenant?
maya: Support attached repro: curl + header x-tenant: solstice. Tenant pinned to model `open-7b-quant` and they set max_tokens=512. Repro prompt is a long multi-turn convo (~1.2k output tokens).
ella: I see a bump in queue time on GPU pool-A (eu-west1); batching increased and a few hosts show repeated KV cache misses.
chris: KV cache misses + long seqs explain tail. Quick mitigations to try:
 - route tenant -> fallback lower-memory model (open-7b-quant-fast)
 - enable per-tenant circuit breaker to 50rps
 - set 503+Retry-After for new requests while we stabilize
 - API-side soft-cap on max_tokens for this tenant
Do we have toggles for these?
oz: We can push a route override to the traffic router. Quick POST to admin API: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://router.internal/override \n -H \"Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN\" \n -d '{"tenant":"solstice","route":{"model":"open-7b-quant-fast","max_rps":50}}'
```
ella: I'll prewarm KV cache on the fallback model and ask infra to bump autoscale for pool-A +2 nodes temporarily.
support-sheriff: Noted — I've applied a soft rate-limit 60rps on the customer key to dampen bursts and updated the ticket with customer-facing message: "We're experiencing higher latency; mitigation in progress — please retry in a few minutes." :pray:
chris: Also add a circuit-breaker rule: if p99 > 2s for 5m then auto-failover to fallback model. I'll open a PR to router defaults. @oz please execute the override and autoscale bump now.
oz: Applying override now. Router response: OK 202 apply-id=ap-9982
sre-bot: Event: route override applied ap-9982 by oz at 2026-03-17T08:23Z
maya: Customer says perf improved but still sees intermittent ~1.5s tails. They asked what caused it.
ella: From traces: root cause looks like a combination of long sequences, hot keying -> cache churn, and batching growth causing head-of-line blocking. Also detected kernel fallback on a subset of hosts due to quantization mismatch; those hosts run slower kernels for certain ops.
chris: Next steps:
 1) spawn a repro job against the affected hosts with identical prompt & headers to reproduce kernel fallback
 2) add kernel-compatibility checks in host onboarding
 3) add autoscale buffer when tenants pin model + high max_tokens
 4) short-term: keep tenant on fallback + use streaming to reduce first-byte latency
oz: Repro job started: job-id=jr-7621. Command: 
```bash
curl -H 'x-tenant: solstice' -H 'X-Model: open-7b-quant' -d @prompt.txt https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate
```
maya: Support asks ETA for root cause and full mitigation.
chris: Tell them: temporary fallback + rate limits applied, running repro to identify kernel mismatch. ETA for full mitigation 4-6 hours, permanent fix later. Offer 30m status updates.
support-sheriff: :thumbsup: I'll update ticket and set 30m follow-up reminders.
ella: I'll prepare a KB draft describing the mitigation playbook (rate limits, circuit-breakers, fallback model/region, streaming, autoscale buffer). Also will open a PR to add the kernel-compatibility perf test.
chris: Also, add router default guardrail: for tenants hitting p99 > 1.5s for 3m, automatically cap new requests to 50rps and prefer fallback models or alternate region. We should include Retry-After/503 semantics for client clarity.
oz: Note: prefix caching is off for this tenant (privacy flag). If they can enable it we could reduce repeated compute. Otherwise streaming helps.
maya: Customer is OK with streaming; I flipped the streaming flag. After fallback + streaming p99 dropped to ~1.1s.
sre-bot: Metric: p99 dropped from 3.8s -> 1.1s at 2026-03-17T08:36Z
chris: Incident mitigated for now. Action items (owners):
 - KB / postmortem draft: ella
 - Router config PR (circuit-breaker + default caps): chris
 - Kernel compatibility investigation & perf test: leo (eng-ml)
 - Autoscale buffer logic for pinned tenants: oz + infra
 - Support messaging template for rate-limits: support-sheriff
leo: Acked. I'll triage kernel logs and repro job jr-7621, will ping with findings in 1-2h.
maya: Thanks all — I'll keep customer in loop and close support ticket once we have RCA. Leaving thread open for roll-up notes. :white_check_mark:
